The Court made the following:
 -2-  THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE P. NAVEEN RAO  AND  THE HON'BLE SMT DR. JUSTICE G. RADHA RANI  WRIT PETITION NO. 1925 OF 2022 ORDER:

(Per Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao) This writ petition is filed praying to grant the following relief:
Salam Sardar vs The State Of Telangana on 3 March, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70163449/
1 "...to issue an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Habeas Corpus directing 3rd Respondent to produce the detenue i.e., Salam Sardar now detained in Central Prison Hyderabad at Chanchalguda,
before this Hon'ble Court and set-aside the impugned detention order passed by the 2nd Respondent vide C.No.452/WRC/CSB-XI/2021 dated 12.08.2021and confirmation order vide G.O.Rt.No.2206 dated 30/09/2021 passed by 1st Respondent as being illegal, arbitrary, improper, unilaterall, unconstitutional and violative of Article 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India and to forthwith release the Detenue and to grant..."
2. Heard Sri Pasham Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home, appearing for the respondents.
3. This writ petition is filed challenging the detention order dated 12.08.2021 made under Section 3(2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders,
Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986) as confirmed by the Government vide G.O.Rt.No.2206 dated 30.09.2021.
4.

entities.text: Salam Sardar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The detaining authority resorted to preventively detain the detenu namely Salam Sardar, on the ground of his involvement in four crimes.
All the four crimes pertain to breaking open the lock of the door of the house and attempting theft of gold ornaments / cash.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner placed reliance on the decisions of this Court in W.P.No.17004 of 2019 and W.P.No.26093 of 2019, wherein this Court considered the issue of resorting to preventive detention on the allegation of involvement in house burglary and theft of gold ornaments / cash.
This Court held that it is not permissible to resort to preventive detention on offences which can be prosecuted in the normal course of enforcement of law and order.
6. Learned Government Pleader does not dispute the fact that in similar circumstances this Court has declared the preventive detention as not warranted in law.

7. Following the decisions of this Court in W.P.No.17004 of 2019 and W.P.No.26093 of 2019, this Writ Petition is also allowed and the impugned detention order passed by the Office of the Commissioner of Police, Warangal - 2nd respondent vide C.No.452/WRC/CSB-XI/2021 dated 12.08.2021 and the consequential confirmation order of the Principal Secretary, General Administration (SPL. (Law & Order) Department, Secretariat, Hyderabad -1st respondent approving the detention vide G.O.Rt.No.2206, General Administration (SPL. (Law & Order) Department dated 30.09.2021, are hereby set aside.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely Salam Sardar, S/o. Abdul Hannan Sardar, Age: 25 years, Caste: Muslim, R/o. Fulbari, Jogendra Nagar,
South 24 Parganas, West Bengal State, temporarily residing in a tin shed near Railway Station,
